About.title: About Us
About.text: Sayoda Travel is a licensed inbound tour operator based in Ashgabat. We prepare the letter of invitation and visa support, arrange guides, transport and hotels, and run the routes ourselves — the Darvaza gas crater, ancient Merv, Nisa, Kunya-Urgench and the Yangykala canyon. Tours across Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan continue the same trip when you want more of Central Asia.
About.whyTitle: Why Book with a Local Operator
whyCardTitle: Permits are part of the route
whyCardText: A Turkmen tourist visa is not issued without a letter of invitation, and only a licensed local operator can apply for one. We prepare it ourselves: you send a passport copy and the form, the rest is our job.
Darvaza, the border zones and several sites need paperwork arranged in advance. We plan it into the itinerary instead of leaving you to discover it at a checkpoint.
Our guides are based in Turkmenistan, not flown in for the season. They know which road is open after rain, when the crater looks best and where to eat in Mary.
About.ctaText: Tell us your dates and what you want to see. We reply with a route and a price per person.

Services.text: Everything a trip to Turkmenistan needs, arranged in one place:
cardtext: We prepare the letter of invitation, submit it, and walk you through collecting the visa at an embassy or on arrival in Ashgabat.
Group departures on fixed dates and private trips on yours, with a local guide who speaks your language.
Cars and drivers for the whole route, hotels in Ashgabat, Mary and Dashoguz, and desert camp nights at Darvaza.
Tell us the dates, the interests and the pace — we build the itinerary around them, neighbouring countries included.

cardtitle: The route is adjusted to you
cardtext: Our own licence and an office in Ashgabat — we are not a reseller working through intermediaries.
A Turkmen visa is not issued without a Letter of Invitation. We prepare and submit it for you.
Join a scheduled departure or travel with your own group, at your own pace.
Turkmen guides who know the history, and drivers who know the roads.
We choose and inspect the hotels ourselves instead of picking them from a catalogue.
Write to us and a person in Ashgabat replies — in English or Russian.
Dates, hotels, pace, extra stops: any programme can be rebuilt around you.
What is included and what is not is listed in full on every tour page.

Browse the ready-made programmes in the Tours section: each one shows the route, duration, guide languages and price per person. If nothing fits, write to us and we will suggest options for your dates.

Not all travelers are the same! Our team will help personalize your itinerary, adjusting activities, accommodations, and travel dates to fit your needs. Want to add extra days or visit a special location? We’ve got you covered.
Once your itinerary is settled, we confirm the booking straight away. Any questions left — just write to us on WhatsApp or by email.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: This page explains what data sayodatravel.com collects, why it is needed and what you can do about it.
Privacy.controllerText: The data is processed by the tour operator {company}. For any question about your data, write to {email}.
Privacy.controllerNoLicense: Company details are published on the contacts page.
Privacy.dataForms: From the enquiry form — your name, phone, email and message. We need them to reply and prepare a tour offer. The basis is your own request: without them we cannot answer.
Privacy.dataAnalytics: Anonymous visit statistics — which pages are opened, in which language and which site you came from. It shows us what is easy to find on the site and what is not.
Privacy.dataChat: Your chat messages, if you use the chat. They are read by the operator answering your questions.
Privacy.cookiesGa: Google Analytics 4 — behaviour statistics. It sets cookies and sends data to Google. Loaded only after your consent.
Privacy.cookiesTawk: Tawk.to — the live chat. It sets cookies so your conversation survives moving between pages. Loaded only after your consent.
Privacy.cookiesOwn: Our own visit counter always works, but it sets no cookies and writes nothing to your device. It does not store your IP address: the database keeps an irreversible fingerprint based in part on the current date, so your visits cannot be linked across different days. The address is used only to work out the country — a two-letter code is stored instead of the address, and the address itself is kept nowhere afterwards.
Privacy.sharingText: Statistics go to Google (with your consent) and chat messages to Tawk.to. Enquiries from the site are shared with nobody: they stay with us and are used only to answer you.
Privacy.retentionText: Enquiries are kept while they are needed to work with you and to confirm what was agreed. Visit records are anonymous from the start and are kept in aggregate. Retention inside Google and Tawk.to follows their own rules.
Privacy.rightsText: You can request a copy of your data, its correction or deletion, and withdraw cookie consent at any time. Write to us and we will respond.
Privacy.changeText: Your choice is saved in this browser. Press to choose again.
Privacy.changeDone: Done — pick an option in the banner at the bottom.
Privacy.notice: If you are unsure what happens to your data, just write to us and we will explain in plain words.
